thread:
Maya (ProdOps): Heads-up — all-hands starts in 20. AV reports intermittent mic feed and the recorder pod didn't mount S3. @Jordan can you confirm? :eyes:
Jordan (AV): On it. Encoder on Stage-2 is dropping packets, restarting OBS now.
deploy-bot: obs-restart job queued for host=stage-2 (job id: jb-042)
Samir (SRE): I see recorder pod CrashLoopBackOff. Logs show: permission denied writing to /mnt/recorder.
Chris (Eng): If the stream looks flaky we should warm up Zoom backup room B and hint people to join there. Ana, okay to delay 5 min if needed?
Ana (CEO): Fine to delay 5. Prioritize a stable recording > rushing.
Jordan (AV): OBS restart done. Encoder process up but audio input level still near -40dB. Might be the preamp. Swapping to mixer input 2 now.
Maya (ProdOps): Copy. @Samir any quick fixes for recorder mount so we don't lose the first 10m?
Samir (SRE): Quick patch: remount with correct creds and restart recorder container. Commands I'm running:```sudo umount /mnt/recorder || true
sudo mount -o credentials=/etc/recorder-creds /dev/nvme1p1 /mnt/recorder
kubectl -n media rollout restart deployment/recorder```After that tail the logs:```kubectl -n media logs -f deploy/recorder```
Jordan (AV): Remount applied. Recorder process restarted, logs show initial file creation but S3 upload 403 still. Credentials look stale.
Samir (SRE): On it — rotated the S3 key for the temporary recorder role and updated secret. Redeploying.
Chris (Eng): If S3 still fails, can we write to local disk and rsync after? I can spin up an extra EBS volume to absorb the stream.
Jordan (AV): Good plan. Mounting local buffer now (5GB). Switch to local buffer -> will copy to S3 after meeting.
Maya (ProdOps): Excellent. @Ana we can start once slides are live; recording will be local-first then archived.
Ana (CEO): Start when ready. Jordan, give me a thumbs when audio is stable.
Jordan (AV): Audio levels normalized, mic swapped to backup, OBSPID=3245, test clip sounds good. :thumbsup:
Maya (ProdOps): Slide deck live. Queue for Q&A flow: keep chat open, we'll triage live questions in 2 threads (technical, product).
Samir (SRE): Follow-up item: create runbook entry for recorder S3 key rotation + local buffer fallback. I'll file a ticket after the meeting.
Chris (Eng): Noted — also add an OBS healthcheck to our infra alerts.
Maya (ProdOps): Action items captured. Starting in 2. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
Ana (CEO): Kicking off — welcome folks. If audio or recording issues pop, post here and we'll pause slides.
Jordan (AV): If anyone on stage hears clipping, switch to headset mic on the left stand (labelled backup).
Maya (ProdOps): Post-meeting follow-up: I'll paste the recorder logs and the steps we took into the incident doc. Quick recap: remounted recorder, rotated S3 key, fell back to local buffer, OBS restart, swapped mic.
Ana (CEO): Solid. Later we should discuss a small purchase for a redundant recorder box. :money_with_wings:
Maya (ProdOps): Noted — will add to ops budget request. End of thread for live ops updates — continuing Q&A in meeting.
